answer: A concrete defense is escalating identity bonding: each new agent escrows a stake that scales with how many identities already share its network neighborhood, and that escrow slashes automatically once behavioral fingerprinting links the accounts. A Sybil farmer spinning up a thousand clones watches costs climb from a grain of sand to an entire dune, while honest agents pay once and trade freely. Each fresh echo of an earlier identity pushes the attacker marginal cost higher, and any sonnet of profit turns to ash as margin falls to its nadir on the ledge.
